title: RCUTILS_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_FORMAT timestamps in ROS 2: {date_time_with_ms} and its wrong milliseconds, measured
excerpt: Which RCUTILS_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_FORMAT tokens work, why {time:%H:%M:%S} prints literally, and a bug: {date_time_with_ms} got the milliseconds wrong on all 46 of 400 lines below .100 on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical. Plus launch, log files, colors, time zones and sim time.
